run.question: Application-gateway server is returning 502 errors in the app-101 namespace. Please investigate.

report.summary: The alert's named entities are not present in the queried target: no namespace named app-101 exists, and no object named application-gateway exists; the only similarly named objects are Service/Deployment frontend-proxy and Service prometheus-readonly-proxy, all in namespace otel-demo (a different entity from the one named in the alert). Kubernetes-level state for the closest analogue looks healthy (frontend-proxy Deployment 1/1 available, generation 1, no rollout; Service frontend-proxy has endpoint 10.244.0.13:8080; all 22 otel-demo pods Running and ready). However, the two signals that could confirm or refute 502s on the gateway were unavailable for the whole investigation: every Prometheus tool call and every Jaeger tool call returned SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, and every pod whose logs I read (frontend-proxy, frontend, load-generator, flagd, prometheus-readonly-proxy) returned zero lines from both the current and the previous container. So no error-rate, error-span or access-log evidence of 502s exists in this Run, no root cause is identified, and the 502 report remains unverified rather than contradicted.

claims.text: The cluster has no namespace named app-101. The namespaces returned by the cluster were default, kube-node-lease, kube-public, kube-system, local-path-storage, opspilot-readonly and otel-demo.

No Kubernetes object named application-gateway exists in this target: the cluster's 29 Services and 24 Deployments contain no object with that name. Filtering Service names on gateway|proxy|101 returned only the Services frontend-proxy and prometheus-readonly-proxy, both in namespace otel-demo, and the full Deployment list contains ad, cart, checkout, currency, email, flagd, frontend, frontend-proxy, image-provider, jaeger, kube-state-metrics, load-generator, otel-collector, payment, product-catalog, prometheus, prometheus-readonly-proxy, quote, recommendation, shipping, valkey-cart plus coredns, metrics-server and local-path-provisioner.

In the related (differently named) workload, Deployment frontend-proxy in namespace otel-demo reports 1 desired, 1 available and 1 ready replica, generation 1 with observedGeneration 1, updatedReplicas 1 and no unavailableReplicas; its conditions are Available=True (reason MinimumReplicasAvailable, lastTransitionTime 2026-11-20T16:32:36Z) and Progressing=True (reason NewReplicaSetAvailable).

Service frontend-proxy in otel-demo selects opentelemetry.io/name=frontend-proxy on port 8080, and the corresponding Endpoints object lists address 10.244.0.13 with port 8080, i.e. the proxy has a live endpoint.

All 22 pods in namespace otel-demo were in phase Running with container ready=true at query time; restart counts were 1 for most pods including frontend-proxy-844799bcdb-pv5mn, 2 for kube-state-metrics-7cbf5b996-df4sz and 3 for prometheus-readonly-proxy-f4866f767-62bgn, and the recorded last termination reason for the pods that restarted once (including frontend-proxy-844799bcdb-pv5mn) was 'Unknown'.

Deployment frontend-proxy is owned by a single ReplicaSet, frontend-proxy-844799bcdb, created 2026-11-20T16:32:07Z with 1 ready replica. The only Deployments in otel-demo with a superseded zero-replica ReplicaSet are otel-collector (old otel-collector-845f9747bd, new otel-collector-789c64b9bf created 2026-11-20T16:33:36Z) and prometheus (old prometheus-547d4cbb8, new prometheus-9bc78b5f7 created 2026-11-20T16:33:37Z); frontend-proxy shows no second ReplicaSet, so no gateway rollout or pod-template change occurred inside the window.

ConfigMap flagd-config in otel-demo stores fault-injection flags for this demo stack (productCatalogFailure, recommendationCacheFailure, adManualGc, adHighCpu, adFailure, kafkaQueueProblems, cartFailure, paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage, imageSlowLoad), each with state ENABLED and defaultVariant 'off', so the stored configuration does not switch any injected fault on.

The frontend-proxy container is configured with FLAGD_HOST=flagd and FLAGD_PORT=8013, i.e. the proxy consults the flagd feature-flag service at runtime; the pod mounts no configuration volume (volumeMounts null), so its Envoy configuration is baked into image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.0.2-frontend-proxy rather than held in a readable ConfigMap.

If 502s are really being produced by frontend-proxy, a runtime-enabled flagd fault flag is one candidate, since the proxy resolves flags from flagd:8013 while the stored ConfigMap defaults are all 'off'; the live flag state and any upstream refusal are unverified because flagd logs and all metrics/trace sources were unavailable.

A crash/restart loop of the gateway pod as the cause of 502s is not supported: frontend-proxy-844799bcdb-pv5mn is Running and ready with restartCount 1, and nearly every other otel-demo pod shows the same single restart with last termination reason 'Unknown' from the environment's bring-up on 2026-11-20, so the pattern is not specific to the gateway.

A broken Service selector or missing endpoint for frontend-proxy is not supported: the Service selector opentelemetry.io/name=frontend-proxy matches the running pod and Endpoints contains 10.244.0.13:8080.

Re-establish the observability path before drawing conclusions about the 502s: verify that the metrics/traces gateway can reach Prometheus (fronted by prometheus-readonly-proxy) and Jaeger, since every Prometheus and Jaeger call in this Run failed with SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE and no error-rate or span data could be obtained.

Confirm which cluster/namespace the app-101 / application-gateway alert refers to; in this target that namespace and object do not exist, and the change-history integration is not available to check whether such a namespace was removed or belongs to another environment.

If 502s are reproduced on frontend-proxy, collect the proxy's own request/upstream error logs (it wrote nothing to stdout in this environment), its Envoy admin stats, and the live flagd flag state for the flags listed in flagd-config, together with the frontend Service's own error signal.

gaps: Prometheus access failed for every query: metrics_range_query, execute_prometheus_instant_query, get_label_values, get_all_labels, list_prometheus_rules and get_prometheus_target all returned status error with reason SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, and Jaeger calls traces_search and traces_list_services likewise returned SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE. Error rate, status-code, latency and span evidence for a 502 condition is therefore unavailable, not zero.

Application logs were unreadable for every pod checked: fetch_pod_logs on frontend-proxy-844799bcdb-pv5mn, frontend-6c9bc688bf-58jmw, load-generator-5ff476786d-xg5nz, flagd-d6485586b-9t42n and prometheus-readonly-proxy-f4866f767-62bgn each returned zero lines for both the current and the previous container instance, so no runtime error text exists in this Run.

The cluster-wide query for events in the window returned no rows (total_items_processed 0), so there is no event-based evidence of evictions, OOM kills, probe failures or rollouts; absence of events here is unknown rather than proof nothing happened.
Queries for ingresses, networkpolicies and resourcequotas across all namespaces returned no rows, so the absence of an ingress/network-policy/quota cause is unverified rather than established.

Whether an environment named app-101 exists outside this target, and what the application-gateway in it is, is unknown: the change_history integration is listed as not integrated, and no object of that name was returned by the Kubernetes tools for this target.

Whether any flagd flag is enabled at runtime could not be checked: the stored ConfigMap shows all defaults 'off', flagd's logs returned no lines and its metrics were unreachable, so the live flag state is unknown.

The Prometheus read path in this environment includes Service prometheus-readonly-proxy (pod prometheus-readonly-proxy-f4866f767-62bgn, restartCount 3, last termination reason Error) and Deployments prometheus / otel-collector each rolled to a new zero-replica-superseded ReplicaSet at 2026-11-20T16:33; whether that affects tool reachability could not be determined because its logs were empty and its metrics source was unreachable.
next_steps: Verify gateway/network reachability and credentials from the investigation tooling to Prometheus (via prometheus-readonly-proxy:9090) and to Jaeger query (16686), then re-run error-rate and span queries for frontend-proxy and frontend.
Identify the correct target for the app-101 namespace / application-gateway alert, or have the alert source corrected if it was produced against a different cluster.

If the gateway is frontend-proxy in otel-demo, pull Envoy access/upstream logs or admin stats and query the flagd flag state for productCatalogFailure, cartFailure, paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable and loadGeneratorFloodHomepage to see whether an injected fault explains upstream 502s.

content:
{"alertmanager.yml":"global: {}
receivers:
- name: opspilot
  webhook_configs:
  - http_config:
      authorization:[REDACTED_CREDENTIAL]        credentials_file: [REDACTED_CREDENTIAL]        type: Bearer
    max_alerts: 0
    send_resolved: true
    url: http://opspilot-web:8080/intake/alertmanager
- name: opspilot-self
route:
  group_by:
  - alertname
  - namespace
  - service
  group_interval: 1m
  group_wait: 10s
  receiver: opspilot
  repeat_interval: 1h
  routes:
  - matchers:
    - opspilot_self="true"
    receiver: opspilot-self
templates: []
"}

{"relay":"connectors:
  spanmetrics: {}
exporters:
  debug: {}
  opensearch:
    http:
      endpoint: http://opensearch:9200
      tls:
        insecure: true
    logs_index: otel
  otlp:
    endpoint: jaeger-collector:4317
    tls:
      insecure: true
  otlphttp/prometheus:
    auth:[REDACTED_CREDENTIAL]      authenticator: basicauth/prometheus
    endpoint: http://prometheus:9090/api/v1/otlp
    tls:
      insecure: true
extensions:
  basicauth/prometheus:
    client_auth:[REDACTED_CREDENTIAL]      password: [REDACTED_CREDENTIAL]      username: collector
  health_check:
    endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:13133
processors:
  batch: {}
  k8sattributes:
    extract:
      metadata:
      - k8s.namespace.name
      - k8s.deployment.name
      - k8s.statefulset.name
      - k8s.daemonset.name
      - k8s.cronjob.name
      - k8s.job.name
      - k8s.node.name
      - k8s.pod.name
      - k8s.pod.uid
      - k8s.pod.start_time
    passthrough: false
    pod_association:
    - sources:
      - from: resource_attribute
        name: k8s.pod.ip
    - sources:
      - from: resource_attribute
        name: k8s.pod.uid
    - sources:
      - from: connection
  memory_limiter:
    check_interval: 5s
    limit_percentage: 80
    spike_limit_percentage: 25
  resource:
    attributes:
    - action: insert
      from_attribute: k8s.pod.uid
      key: service.instance.id
  transform:
    error_mode: ignore
    trace_statements:
    - context: span
      statements:
      - replace_pattern(name, "\\?.*", "")
      - replace_match(name, "GET /api/products/*", "GET /api/products/{productId}")
receivers:
  httpcheck/frontend-proxy:
    targets:
    - endpoint: http://frontend-proxy:8080
  jaeger:
    protocols:
      grpc:
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:14250
      thrift_compact:
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:6831
      thrift_http:
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:14268
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc:
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:4317
      http:
        cors:
          allowed_origins:
          - http://*
          - https://*
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:4318
  prometheus:
    config:
      scrape_configs:
      - job_name: opentelemetry-collector
        scrape_interval: 10s
        static_configs:
        - targets:
          - ${env:MY_POD_IP}:8888
  redis:
    collection_interval: 10s
    endpoint: valkey-cart:6379
  zipkin:
    endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:9411
service:
  extensions:
  - health_check
  - basicauth/prometheus
  pipelines:
    logs:
      exporters:
      - debug
      processors:
      - k8sattributes
      - memory_limiter
      - resource
      - batch
      receivers:
      - otlp
    metrics:
      exporters:
      - otlphttp/prometheus
      - debug
      processors:
      - k8sattributes
      - memory_limiter
      - resource
      - batch
      receivers:
      - httpcheck/frontend-proxy
      - redis
      - otlp
      - spanmetrics
    traces:
      exporters:
      - otlp
      - debug
      - spanmetrics
      processors:
      - k8sattributes
      - memory_limiter
      - resource
      - transform
      - batch
      receivers:
      - otlp
      - jaeger
      - zipkin
  telemetry:
    metrics:
      level: detailed
      readers:
      - periodic:
          exporter:
            otlp:
              endpoint: otel-collector:4318
              protocol: grpc
          interval: 10000
          timeout: 5000
"}

{"alerting_rules.yml":"groups:
- name: opspilot-lab
  rules:
  - alert: CheckoutPlaceOrderErrorRatioHigh
    annotations:
      description: '{{ $value | humanizePercentage }} of checkout PlaceOrder server
        spans ended in error over the last 5 minutes.'
      summary: checkout PlaceOrder error ratio above 50%
    expr: |
      label_replace(label_replace(
        (sum by (k8s_namespace_name, service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{k8s_namespace_name="otel-demo",service_name="checkout",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",span_name=~".*CheckoutService/PlaceOrder",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[5m])))
        /
        (sum by (k8s_namespace_name, service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{k8s_namespace_name="otel-demo",service_name="checkout",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",span_name=~".*CheckoutService/PlaceOrder"}[5m])))
      , "namespace", "$1", "k8s_namespace_name", "(.*)"), "service", "$1", "service_name", "(.*)")
      > 0.5
    for: 2m
    labels:
      cluster: opspilot-m1
      opspilot_integration_id: m0-otel-20260909
      severity: critical
- name: opspilot-self
  rules:
  - alert: OpsPilotAgentAbsent
    annotations:
      description: role {{ $labels.role }} ({{ $labels.instance }}) has not answered
        /metrics for 2 minutes.
      summary: an OpsPilot health listener is down or the worker is not scraped
    expr: up{job="opspilot"} == 0 or absent(up{job="opspilot",role="worker"})
    for: 2m
    labels:
      opspilot_self: "true"
      severity: critical
  - alert: OpsPilotModelCallsFailing
    annotations:
      description: '{{ $value }} consecutive model calls failed on {{ $labels.instance
        }}.'
      summary: OpsPilot model calls are failing
    expr: opspilot_model_consecutive_failures >= 2
    for: 1m
    labels:
      opspilot_self: "true"
      severity: critical
","alerts":"{}
","allow-snippet-annotations":"false","prometheus.yml":"global:
  evaluation_interval: 1m
  scrape_interval: 1m
  scrape_timeout: 10s
storage:
  tsdb:
    out_of_order_time_window: 30m
otlp:
    keep_identifying_resource_attributes: true
    promote_resource_attributes:
    - opspilot.integration.id
    - service.instance.id
    - service.name
    - service.namespace
    - service.version
    - cloud.availability_zone
    - cloud.region
    - deployment.environment.name
    - k8s.cluster.name
    - k8s.container.name
    - k8s.cronjob.name
    - k8s.daemonset.name
    - k8s.deployment.name
    - k8s.job.name
    - k8s.namespace.name
    - k8s.node.name
    - k8s.pod.name
    - k8s.replicaset.name
    - k8s.statefulset.name
    - container.name
    - host.name
rule_files:
- /etc/config/recording_rules.yml
- /etc/config/alerting_rules.yml
- /etc/config/rules
- /etc/config/alerts
scrape_configs:
- job_name: prometheus
  static_configs:
  - targets:
    - localhost:9090
- bearer_token_file: [REDACTED_CREDENTIAL]  job_name: kubernetes-apiservers
  kubernetes_sd_configs:
  - role: endpoints
  relabel_configs:
  - action: keep
    regex: default;kubernetes;https
    source_labels:
    - __meta_kubernetes_namespace
    - __meta_kubernetes_service_name
    - __meta_kubernetes_endpoint_port_name
  scheme: https
  tls_config:
    ca_file: /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/ca.crt
- bearer_token_file: [REDACTED_CREDENTIAL]  job_name: kubernetes-nodes
  kubernetes_sd_configs:
  - role: node
  relabel_configs:
  - action: labelmap
    regex: __meta_kubernetes_node_label_(.+)
  - replacement: kubernetes.default.svc:443
    target_label: __address__
  - regex: (.+)
    replacement: /api/v1/nodes/$1/proxy/metrics
    source_labels:
    - __meta_kubernetes_node_name
    target_label: __metrics_path__
  scheme: https
  tls_config:
    ca_file: /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/ca.crt
- bearer_token_file: [REDACTED_CREDENTIAL]  job_name: kubernetes-nodes-cadvisor
  kubernetes_sd_configs:
  - role: node
  relabel_configs:
  - action: labelmap
    regex: __meta_kubernetes_node_label_(.+)
  - replacement: kubernetes.default.svc:443
    target_label: __address__
  - regex: (.+)
    replacement: /api/v1/nodes/$1/proxy/metrics/cadvisor
    source_labels:
    - __meta_kubernetes_node_name
    target_label: __metrics_path__
  scheme: https
  tls_config:
    ca_file: /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/ca.crt
- honor_labels: true
  job_name: kubernetes-service-endpoints
  kubernetes_sd_configs:
  - role: endpoints
  relabel_configs:
  - action: keep
    regex: true
    source_labels:
    - __meta_kubernetes_service_annotation_prometheus_io_scrape
  - action: drop
    regex: true
    source_labels:
    - __meta_kubernetes_service_annotation_prometheus_io_scrape_slow
  - action: replace
    regex: (https?)
    source_labels:
    - __meta_kubernetes_service_annotation_prometheus_io_scheme
    target_label: __scheme__
  - action: replace
    regex: (.+)
    source_labels:
    - __meta_kubernetes_service_annotation_prometheus_io_path
    target_label: __metrics_path__
  - action: replace
    regex: (.+?)(?::\d+)?;(\d+)
    replacement: $1:$2
    source_labels:
    - __address__
    - __meta_kubernetes_service_annotation_prometheus_io_port
    target_label: __address__
  - action: labelmap
    regex: __meta_kubernetes_service_annotation_prometheus_io_param_(.+)
    replacement: __param_$1
  - action: labelmap
    regex: __meta_kubernetes_service_label_(.+)
  - action: replace
    source_labels:
    - __meta_kubernetes_namespace
    target_label: namespace
  - action: replace
    source_labels:
    - __meta_kubernetes_service_name
    target_label: service
  - action: replace
    source_labels:
    - __meta_kubernetes_pod_node_name
    target_label: node
- honor_labels: true
  job_name: kubernetes-service-endpoints-slow
  kubernetes_sd_configs:
